title: Lesson 3: RISC-V Assembly & the Datapath — js-tools
desc: The RV32I R-type/I-type/S-type formats, assembling Assembly into 32-bit machine code exactly per the real specification, and designing a single-cycle datapath. Verified by running a hand-written engine: ADD x3,x1,x2 assembles to 0x2081b3 and SUB (same opcode, different funct7) to 0x402081b3; the assemble-decode round trip matches on all 11 mnemonics; a real RV32I program computing (5+3)-2 runs through the datapath giving x5=6 and storing/reloading mem[100] correctly. Demo: type an assembly instruction, watch the bit breakdown and the datapath light up.
descPlain: The RV32I R/I/S-type formats, assembling Assembly into 32-bit machine code, and a single-cycle datapath. Demo: type Assembly, see the bit breakdown and the data path light up.
